_readme: Art-direction manifest for images generated with Higgsfield (Recraft V4.1 Pro). Run `npm run images:generate` (see README). Generated files land in public/images/generated/ and are registered in data/generated-assets.json. The website never calls Higgsfield at request time.
styleSuffix: Premium creative agency art direction, editorial product photography, controlled studio lighting, realistic materials, soft shadows, shallow depth of field, clean uncluttered background, consistent cool colour grade, high detail, no people, no hands, no readable text, no letters, no words, no watermarks, no brand logos.

assets.alt: A laptop and phone showing elegant website layouts beside printed brand identity cards on a dark studio surface
assets.prompt: A sleek laptop and a smartphone floating at slight angles above a matte black surface, both screens showing elegant minimalist website layouts built from clean geometric colour blocks and soft gradients, beside a neat stack of printed brand identity cards and colour swatch chips, rim lighting in electric blue and cyan from the left and a faint ultraviolet glow from the right, dark moody studio.

assets.usage: About page and supporting abstract visual
assets.alt: Two glossy interlocking ribbons in blue, cyan and violet on a black background
assets.prompt: Abstract sculpture of two wide glossy ribbons folding and interlocking at sharp angles, satin material with smooth gradients from cyan to electric blue to ultraviolet, floating on a pure black background, crisp reflections, minimalist and premium.

assets.alt: Desktop and tablet screens showing a refined website layout on a dark desk
assets.prompt: A large desktop monitor and a tablet on a dark walnut desk showing a refined, airy website homepage layout made of abstract colour blocks and image placeholders, a printed wireframe sheet with pencil sketches beside them, cool blue accent light.

assets.alt: A laptop with abstract code editor colours glowing in a dark workspace
assets.prompt: Close-up of a laptop in a dark workspace, the screen showing an abstract code editor made of coloured horizontal lines in cyan, blue and violet on near-black, mechanical keyboard in soft focus, subtle reflections on the desk.

assets.alt: A smartphone showing a product grid next to minimal skincare bottles
assets.prompt: A smartphone leaning on a minimal stone plinth, screen showing an online store product grid of abstract product tiles, surrounded by three unbranded matte cosmetic bottles and a small shopping bag, soft studio light with cool blue accents.

assets.alt: A monitor showing a modular page builder interface with colourful content blocks
assets.prompt: A monitor displaying an abstract modular page-builder interface: a sidebar of block thumbnails and a canvas of stacked content sections as clean colour blocks, one block highlighted with an electric blue outline, dark minimal desk setup.

assets.alt: Layered translucent glass panels representing interface components
assets.prompt: Layered translucent frosted glass panels stacked in depth like interface components, each edge catching cyan and blue light, a faint grid underneath, floating on black, precise and technical feel.

assets.alt: A tall smartphone showing a single focused landing page with a bright call-to-action block
assets.prompt: A single smartphone standing upright on a black reflective surface, the screen showing a tall focused landing page layout with a bold hero block and one bright electric blue call-to-action button shape, dramatic spotlight from above.

assets.alt: An old cluttered page printout beside a tablet showing a clean modern layout
assets.prompt: Side-by-side comparison on a dark desk: a crumpled greyscale printout of a cluttered old web page on the left, and a tablet showing a clean, spacious modern layout with blue and cyan accents on the right, soft directional light.

assets.alt: Paper wireframes and sticky notes arranged into a user flow on a dark board
assets.prompt: Overhead view of paper wireframe cards for mobile screens arranged into a user flow on a dark felt board, connected by thin cyan threads, a few blank violet sticky notes, tidy and considered composition.

assets.alt: A geometric mark drawn on tracing paper over a construction grid
assets.prompt: Tracing paper on a black drafting table showing a bold abstract geometric symbol with circular construction guides and grid lines, a technical pen and compass beside it, crisp cyan accent light, craftsmanship and precision.

assets.alt: A flat lay of brand stationery, colour swatches and a tote bag
assets.prompt: Elegant flat lay of unbranded brand identity applications: business cards, letterhead, envelope, a tote bag and fanned colour swatch cards in electric blue, cyan, violet and off-white, arranged on a dark slate surface with precise spacing.

assets.alt: Printed posters, a folded brochure and flyers fanned out on a dark table
assets.prompt: Printed marketing collateral fanned across a dark table: two abstract geometric posters, a tri-fold brochure and small flyers with bold colour blocking in blue, cyan and violet, soft daylight with gentle shadows.

assets.alt: A phone showing a grid of colourful square posts beside printed post designs
assets.prompt: A smartphone lying on a black surface showing a cohesive grid of square social posts made of abstract colour blocks, surrounded by several printed square post designs in the same style, playful but tidy arrangement.

assets.alt: An abstract glass sculpture of a magnifying lens over a structured grid of blocks
assets.prompt: A polished glass magnifying lens hovering over an orderly isometric grid of small white blocks arranged like a site structure, one path of blocks lit in cyan, black background, clean and conceptual.

assets.alt: Precision tools laid out neatly next to a laptop on a dark surface
assets.prompt: Precision tools such as a small screwdriver set and calipers laid out in a neat row beside a closed slim laptop on a dark surface, a thin cyan light line reflecting across the tools, calm and reliable mood.

assets.alt: Concept: deep green coffee bags with copper details on a cream backdrop
assets.prompt: Packaging still life for a specialty coffee roaster: two matte deep forest green coffee bags with copper foil detailing, a ceramic cup and scattered coffee beans, warm cream background, soft window light.

assets.alt: Concept: a calm clinic website on a tablet in a bright minimal room
assets.prompt: A tablet on a white oak counter in a calm, bright minimal clinic reception, the screen showing an airy website layout in navy and mint colour blocks, a small plant and soft natural light.

assets.alt: Concept: a navy website on a laptop in a logistics office with yellow accents
assets.prompt: A laptop in a modern logistics office at dusk showing a bold website layout in deep navy with signal-yellow accents, blurred shipping containers visible through the window, cinematic light.

assets.alt: Concept: botanical skincare bottles and a phone showing an online shop
assets.prompt: Unbranded botanical skincare bottles in botanical green and clay tones on warm stone, beside a smartphone showing an online shop product grid, eucalyptus sprigs, soft diffused light with gentle shadows.

assets.alt: Concept: black gym apparel and posters with electric lime accents
assets.prompt: Black training apparel and a water bottle with electric lime accents laid out on dark rubber gym flooring next to printed square posters with bold slanted shapes, high contrast dramatic light.

assets.alt: Concept: an analytics dashboard on a monitor in a dark violet-lit room
assets.prompt: A widescreen monitor in a dark room displaying an abstract analytics dashboard with charts and cards in violet and teal on deep navy, subtle violet ambient light, sleek and modern.

assets.alt: Concept: architectural stationery and drawings on warm paper with timber
assets.prompt: Architectural studio stationery flat lay: warm off-white letterheads, rolled drawings, a timber sample and a stone sample, precise minimal arrangement, soft daylight, neutral palette with an earthy brown accent.

assets.alt: Concept: a restaurant menu and table card in saffron and spice brown
assets.prompt: A restaurant table setting with a printed menu card and small table card in saffron gold and deep spice brown on cream paper, sunburst pattern details, warm candlelit atmosphere, shared plates softly out of focus.
